title: Mobile Phone Reception Coverage in Lifts in New HDB Developments to Facilitate Emergency Calls
what_it_is: Mobile Phone Reception Coverage in Lifts in New HDB Developments to Facilitate Emergency Calls

sections.label: HDB lift design and monitoring
sections.summary: HDB lifts comply with codes, have no required mobile coverage, and are monitored by the Tele-Monitoring System for breakdowns and rescues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Lifts in Housing and Development Board (HDB) developments are designed and installed in compliance with the prevailing Codes and Regulations, and requirements set by relevant Authorities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As part of the Infocomm Media Development Authority's (IMDA’s) quality-of-service standards, mobile operators are required to provide more than 85% service coverage in each building.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There is no requirement to provide mobile coverage inside lifts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Lifts in HDB developments are equipped with and monitored by the Tele-Monitoring System (TMS), which can automatically detect a lift breakdown and alert the lift maintenance contractors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: When the alarm button is pressed during a lift breakdown, an alert will be sent via the TMS to the Essential Maintenance Services Unit (EMSU), which will then dispatch a rescue team to assist anyone who may be trapped.

sections.label: No mobile coverage requirements
sections.summary: There are currently no planning requirements for mobile coverage within HDB lifts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As I have explained, at the moment, there are no planning requirements for mobile coverage within HDB lifts.

sections.label: Boosting weak lift coverage
sections.summary: HDB will work with telecommunications operators to discuss boosting mobile coverage in HDB lifts where it is weak, including Clementi Peaks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Nevertheless, we acknowledge that there may be times where residents or volunteers notice that the mobile coverage in HDB lifts might be weak and would like it to be made stronger, in which case HDB will work with the telecommunications operators to discuss with them and also to see if coverage can be boosted.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In the case of Clementi Peaks, we will follow up.
